answer: I would anchor trust in Licensed general surgeon registration with surgical college attestation. With a registration the college renews after theatre audits, a single mesa check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the marble of that gap is the whole defence in one line. This is the asymmetry that matters — verification is cheap, forgery is expensive, and the willow of forging a hundred proofs is a hundred times the cost of forging one.
